date_note: KEPCO announced the leak on 22 November and said it confirmed it on 20 November (Newsis, Dailian, Segye Ilbo); no page gives the day of the intrusion.
title: KEPCO says personal data of over one and a half million people leaked from its customer and procurement systems
geo_basis: KEPCO headquarters in Naju; the sources give no location for the affected systems
summary: KEPCO said on 22 November it confirmed on 20 November a leak from Hanjeon ON and the SRM procurement system: 1,520,248 people by simple sum (Newsis, Seoul Economic Daily), overlap unchecked (Dailian). Exposed: resident registration, bank account and card numbers. Dailian says KEPCO presumes an outside attacker; BleepingComputer says a user called Noiem claimed the breach on a hacker forum on 19 November, unconfirmed. The Personal Information Protection Commission will run on-site inspections (Etnews).
plain: South Korea's power company KEPCO says personal data of over one and a half million people, including ID, bank account and card numbers, leaked from two of its online systems; it presumes an outside attacker.
exec: Personal data from a national utility's customer and supplier systems leaked, including ID, bank and card numbers that can be used for fraud and impersonation.
action: KEPCO urges caution with calls, texts and emails that impersonate KEPCO or come from unclear sources, and runs a dedicated service where customers can check whether their data leaked and report damage.

sources.name: Seoul Economic Daily (Joo Jae-hyun, Lee Jung-hoon; AI-translated English edition)

evidence.quote: 개인정보위는 한전의 개인정보 유출 신고를 접수하고 초동대응반을 구성해 현장점검을 실시한다고 23일 밝혔다.
A simple sum puts the number of people whose sensitive information was compromised at 1,520,248.
From the SRM system, four categories of data on 426,827 people who took part in procurement were exposed
Six categories of data on 442,934 KEPCO and corporate employees who used the system were also breached
The ministry said the data breach is not currently affecting power operations.
두 시스템에서 개인정보가 유출된 인원은 단순 합산 기준 152만248명이다.
두 시스템의 유출 규모를 합하면 152만248명분에 달한다. 다만 중복 인원 여부는 확인되지 않았다.
한전은 외부 공격자가 두 시스템에 불법 침입해 정보를 탈취한 것으로 추정하고 있다.
한전은 지난 20일 통합고객서비스플랫폼인 '한전ON'과 전자조달시스템(SRM)에서 개인정보 유출 사실을 확인했다고 22일 밝혔다.
has confirmed another data breach involving the personal information of around 1.52 million users

validation.note: Newsis, Dailian and Segye Ilbo each report KEPCO's 22 November statement with the same per-system figures and CEO Kim Dong-cheol's apology. KEPCO's own apology notice was not read: home.kepco.co.kr timed out and online.kepco.co.kr reset the connection. No attacker named; Dailian says KEPCO presumes an external attacker. The sources give counts in Korean notation (152만248명 total; Hanjeon ON 65만487명, SRM 86만9761명); the record keeps that notation with words because the figure check cannot read it. The Korea Herald (22 November) adds that KEPCO launched an investigation in cooperation with the National Intelligence Service, relevant government agencies and outside experts. The Korea Times (Yonhap, 22 November) gives the same per-system counts (650,487 KEPCO ON users, 869,761 SRM users) and says KEPCO disclosed a separate breach of 35,528 people a month earlier. Seoul Economic Daily (23 November, AI-translated English edition) splits the SRM count into 426,827 procurement participants and 442,934 KEPCO and corporate employees, says KEPCO blocked IP access at 6 a.m. on 20 November and filed with the Personal Information Protection Commission at 6:30 p.m. on 22 November, and reports the climate ministry saying the breach is not currently affecting power operations. Etnews (23 November) reports the Personal Information Protection Commission saying on 23 November it received KEPCO's leak report, formed an initial response team and will carry out on-site inspections to establish the leak route and scale; Etnews also says KEPCO received a hacker's extortion email on the 19th.
